name: Selonabant
summary: Selonabant is a cannabinoid CB1 receptor antagonist which is under development for the treatment of acute cannabinoid intoxication. It was also previously being developed to treat obesity, but development for this indication was discontinued. The drug is administered by intravenous infusion. It dramatically reduced the subjective effects of Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) in a clinical trial.

pharmacology.text: Selonabant (INN, USAN; developmental code names ANEB-001, V-24343) is a cannabinoid CB1 receptor antagonist which is under development for the treatment of acute cannabinoid intoxication.

fact.en: Selonabant blocks the CB1 receptor, so it is being developed as an antidote for cannabis poisoning, especially in children who eat edibles.
fact.zh: Selonabant 阻斷 CB1 受體，因此正被開發作為大麻中毒的解毒劑，特別是針對誤食大麻食品的兒童。
